```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 1.1. Import metadata


# Import metadata
metadata_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "metadata_df.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)






# 1.2. Define workflow parameters


# Define parameters
Definite <- table(metadata_df$LRTI_adjudication)["Definite"]
No_Evidence <- table(metadata_df$LRTI_adjudication)["No Evidence"]
npatients <- Definite + No_Evidence

# Store parameters as data frame
Parameters <- data.frame(
  Count = c(
    npatients,
    Definite,
    No_Evidence,
    nfolds,
    ntrees
  )
)

rownames(Parameters) <- c(
  "Patients",
  "Definite",
  "No Evidence",
  "Folds",
  "RF Trees"
)






```
